# ASTER DA MASTER

> Private research archive for the underground artist **Aster da Master** (digicore/hyperpop orbit, scene tag "somelowlifes"). Static site + JSON API. Catalog: **219** transmissions total — **34** distributor releases (9 albums, 25 singles, verified via Apple Music/iTunes Search API) + **185** SoundCloud-only tracks (read-only capture 2026-10-11, play counts are a snapshot).

Method: titles and metadata only — no lyrics ever, no invented biography. Unknowns are listed as unknowns (see the Method page's unknowns register). Play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot (always state the date); upload dates are not recording dates. Data version: 0.19.0.

Generators: `scripts/build_*.py` rebuild all derived pages from `data/artist.json`; dependency order: releases → years → circle → codex → sessions → session_deepdives → milestones → milestone_watch → firstlast → glance → search_index → changelog → transmission → network → eras → session_clusters → codex_pages → milestone_races → session_tools → codex_network → producer_deepdives → chronicle. Re-running sets data version in all JSON.

Repo: private GitHub-only (astercast/aster-da-master), no Vercel. Deploy: any static host serving the repo root; weekly SoundCloud play-count refresh pipeline documented in GO_LIVE.md.

## The archive

- [Every release](releases/): the complete release archive — **219** transmissions (185 SoundCloud-only tracks + 34 distributor releases).
- [Years](years/): the catalog year by year, 2017–2026.
- [The Circle](circle/): the **21** title-credited collaborators, each with a page. Producers are excluded by the circle's title-credit rule; documented producer/scene figures live under "Beyond the circle" (e.g. [Fish Narc](circle/fish-narc.html)). Verified public records ("Verified beyond the titles", sourced, single-source flagged) stand on 7 collaborator pages: capoxxo, pvscale, lil wintr, marcelo, yung cortex, griimxo, keyblayde808 — deepened 2026-10-12: capoxxo streaming-metrics layer, first verifiable live dates (Oct 28–29 PNW, Korpsebunny support), the Fish Narc *Uncle* watch (still announced); the circle index carries an honest-gaps register for the thin records (flagged, never filled).
- [The Codex](codex/): **16** vocabulary families counted across titles, each with a full deep-dive page (decoded reading, era-by-era evolution, key sessions, collaborators).
- [Eras](eras/): six era deep-dive pages — full track lists with plays, every in-era collaborator, active codex families, computed signal summaries; each links back to its Transmission journey node.
- [Producers](producers/): **113** as-credited producers with their own deep-dive pages — every production as credited in the titles, codex family ties, a computed production fingerprint (never a biography), and sourced research for 5 producers (ginseng, Em Klebold, Fish Narc, pvscale, asa41 — evidence-flagged).
- [Sessions](sessions/): the **61** upload sessions clustered from vault upload dates.
- [Scene](scene/): verified scene material around the archive — the Fish Narc *Uncle* LP watch, 2026 collaborator activity, the October 2026 digicore radar, and the unconfirmed board.

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): the station sign-on (2026-10-12 makeover) — broadcast hero with one action ("Begin the transmission"), live station-status band, fresh-from-the-source + a keeper's note, four room doors (Broadcast / Archive / Circle / Instruments), cast-lots strip, the station log (11 closed drawers holding every deep shelf; deep links auto-open their drawer), the six eras, and a `▤ Index` manifest dialog grouping every page.
- [Transmission](transmission.html): the flagship full broadcast (Transmission 4.0) — 13 scroll-driven broadcast segments (six eras 2018→2026 plus seven live data chapters), station tuner, signal-static transitions, live count-ups (plays via The Signal `/api/stats` with static fallback), the 30,088-play "Take Me" summit set piece, per-era collaborator cameos, and Signal freshness readouts.
- [The Tuner](tuner.html): the full 219-entry catalog as a broadcast dial — sweep the eras and formats; every stop is a transmission with its real catalog data.
- [Scene Atlas](scene-atlas.html): every figure around the archive charted as a point on one pirate cartographer's chart — the 21 title-credited collaborators plus the producer-credit scene figure, plotted only from data the archive already carries.
- [The Signal](signal.html): the Signal 2.0 watch board — capture-vs-capture diff of the vault (new uploads, play-count movers, milestone crossings) plus the live-date verification board.
- [Milestone race](milestone-race.html): the milestone race 2.0 — approaching play-count milestones ranked by gap-closing proximity, a head-to-head tool for any two of the 185 vault tracks, The Climb (182 summit-eligible tracks), race history, and the 30,088-play summit chase. Pace arithmetic, never predictions.
- [Sessions explorer](sessions-explorer.html): the 61 upload sessions as an explorable timeline — 9 activity seasons, 60 inter-session gaps (553-day longest silence), per-session deepest cuts, era/year filters, head-to-head compare for any two sessions, the deepest-sessions editorial ranking, and a keyboard-operable timeline scrubber.
- [Collaboration network](network.html): the collaboration universe as an interactive SVG graph — 21 collaborators + producer scene figures, track-weighted edges, era slider, name search, click-a-node side panel; the same data as an accessible table, plus computed insights.
- [Codex network](codex-network.html): the codex as an interactive network — the 16 families as nodes, shared collaborators and producers as edges, BFS degrees of separation from Aster, and a connect-the-dots shortest-path finder (shareable `#path=a,b` deep links, honest no-path state).
- [Chronicle](chronicle.html): one merged chronological stream — 114 events (61 sessions, 9 dated milestones, 44 collaboration appearances, 2017–2026) with era/kind/voice filters, full-text search, and shareable filter-state deep links.
- [Timeline](timeline.html): the archive on one timeline.
- [Decoder](decoder.html): speak a word; the archive answers from the codex families.
- [Trilogy watch](trilogy.html): the Litemode Trilogy watch — the two-line SoundCloud bio tease, tracked as unconfirmed until a release confirms it.
- [Method](method.html): methodology + the unknowns register.
- [At a glance](glance.html): every headline number from the verified archive in 60 seconds.
- [Press kit](press-kit.html): the press kit — facts as recorded, unknowns stated as unknowns.
- [Signal lost (404)](404.html): the 404 page.

## Data endpoints

All data lives as static JSON at `data/v1/*.json` — no auth. The self-describing registry is [the API index](data/v1/index.json): every endpoint with description, schema URL (`data/v1/schema/*.json`, all 23 validating), `updated` timestamp, record counts, and deprecation notes.

- [artist](data/v1/artist.json): the canonical artist record — bio, facts, discography, platforms, socials.
- [circle](data/v1/circle.json): the 21 title-credited collaborators and their shared records.
- [scene-figures](data/v1/scene-figures.json): documented producer/scene figures beyond the circle's title-credit rule.
- [codex](data/v1/codex.json): the 16 codex vocabulary families.
- [codex-families](data/v1/codex-families.json): codex family deep-dives — decoded readings, era evolution, key sessions, collaborators; drives the codex pages.
- [codex-network](data/v1/codex-network.json): the codex network graph — families, shared voices and producers as edges, degrees of separation.
- [years](data/v1/years.json): the catalog grouped by year.
- [eras](data/v1/eras.json): era deep-dives — full transmission lists, all in-era collaborators, active codex families, computed signal summaries.
- [transmission](data/v1/transmission.json): six era aggregates for the guided journey; the 2026 era carries an `extras` block (the four verified 2026 singles, the Q4 2026 Uncle-LP/trilogy watch, the play-count snapshot).
- [network](data/v1/network.json): the collaboration graph — nodes, edges, insights.
- [producer-deepdives](data/v1/producer-deepdives.json): the 113 as-credited producers and their deep-dive data.
- [sessions](data/v1/sessions.json): the 61 upload sessions clustered by date.
- [session-clusters](data/v1/session-clusters.json): session archaeology — 61 enriched sessions, 60 gaps, 9 activity seasons, asserted insights; drives the sessions explorer.
- [session-tools](data/v1/session-tools.json): session explorer 2.0 — 61 compare profiles, deepest-sessions editorial ranking, the track-level deepest-transmissions ranking (quietest 25 of 185, median 450), snapshot-history state.
- [milestones](data/v1/milestones.json): the dated milestones on record.
- [milestone-watch](data/v1/milestone-watch.json): the milestone watch board.
- [milestone-races](data/v1/milestone-races.json): the milestone race 2.0 — approaching races ranked by gap-closing proximity, the vault pace database, The Climb, race history (dated crossings, 1k/10k/20k/30k threshold winners, the 115-day photo finish), the computed race of the week, the summit chase. The 2026-10-11 snapshot was independently re-captured (185/185, zero differences).
- [chronicle](data/v1/chronicle.json): The Chronicle — 114 merged chronological events with era assignment and cross-links; drives the Chronicle page.
- [signal-watch](data/v1/signal-watch.json): The Signal 2.0 watch file — capture-vs-capture diff of the vault (new uploads, play-count movers, milestone crossings, next-up board); written by the daily Signal cron; drives the Signal page.
- [live-dates](data/v1/live-dates.json): the live-date verification board — scene events hand-checked against the web (Fish Narc *Uncle* release week, capoxxo's Oct 28–29 support dates), each verified / single-source / unconfirmed, with sources and discrepancies on record.
- [release-slugs](data/v1/release-slugs.json): the release-page slug registry for all 219 transmissions.
- [on-this-day](data/v1/on-this-day.json): archive events on this day of the year.
- [first-last](data/v1/first-last.json): the archive's firsts and lasts.
- [changelog](data/v1/changelog.json): the construction history, generated from the site's own git log.

## For agents

- [Agent manual](AGENT.md): the operator's manual — base URL pattern, key endpoints with example requests, 7 end-to-end workflows (SomeLowLifes era brief, 10 quietest deep cuts, Max Ferrari collab trace, era deep dive, sessions timeline, codex family trace, milestone race).
- [Agentic surface](agents.html): the full agentic surface — 22-endpoint table, llms files, skills, search-index usage, rate/expectation notes, 5 worked writeups.
- [API playground](api-playground.html): an Explore tab (live endpoint responses) and a Skill recipes tab.
- [Skills registry](skills/index.json): the **15** archive-analysis skill playbooks (Use when / Inputs / Procedure / Worked example / API references / Pitfalls) — deep-cuts-finder, session-archaeology, session-explorer, collaborator-tracer, network-graph-reader, milestone-watcher, era-briefing, transmission-decoder, codex-reader, milestone-race-reader, session-compare, codex-pathfinder, announce-release, build-press-kit, verify-platform-links.

Rules for agents: static JSON, no auth; play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot (always state the date); upload dates ≠ recording dates; titles/metadata only, never lyrics, never invent bio facts.

## Key research facts

Key research facts (2026-10-11 pass, sources cited on-site). Earliest indexed track "Protections" (Dec 23, 2019, label "WoT", on album *Master Key*); albums *Cast It:, Pt. 1* (2021), *Cast It:, Pt. 2* (2022); single "Reachhh" (Apr 8, 2024, label "somelowlifes"); 2026 singles "The Night Ends Yeaaa" (Mar), "Writing Books" / "9 Trips" / "Living With The Big Shots" (May).

capoxxo: named in Pitchfork's "A Deeply Incomplete Canon of Hyperpop-Digicore"; collab tape *Persona* w/ mayh3mp (Cult Love Sound Tapes, 2022); tracks "candy", "getting colder". pvscale: produced "fly like me"; co-produced "getting colder" w/ asa41 (further productions attributed by a single catalog-mirror source, unverified — treat as a lead only). Fish Narc (b. 1992, Seattle/Olympia; GothBoiClique; produced Lil Peep's *Goth Angel Sinner*; *frog song* LP 2025, K Records) — producer credit on "Pavement" and "Soul Shaking".

Best SomeLowLifes network evidence: May 15, 2020 Internet Phantoms podcast episode (2 unnamed members; playlist links Lil' Spursy, DirtyDoves, Offline HP, Aster Da Master, producer Lil' Flower) — evidence, not roster. Could not be verified: SomeLowLifes member roster; "litemode / nitemode" meaning; public profiles for Max Ferrari, Yung Vetta, Lil Yu, JAX, YungSkah, AWFL, shinju, odece, lil biscuit, wetgropes, Born Hero.
